Food regulator issues notices to Swiggy Instamart over expired and spoiled products

The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has issued notices to Swiggy Instamart for allegedly delivering expired and spoiled food products. This move comes amid growing concerns over food safety in the country's rapidly expanding e-commerce market.
